statement: Equinix says eight of the top 10 AI model providers and nine of the top 10 AI clouds are deployed with it, across more than 280 data centers in 77 metros with 230 cloud on-ramps.
why: Nearly the whole set of large AI buyers sitting inside one colocation footprint means that operator's platform choices steer a lot of accelerator demand.

impact.mechanism: Concentration of AI model providers and clouds in one interconnection estate gives that estate's reference-architecture choice outsized influence on which accelerators get deployed.

evidence.excerpt: Eight of the top 10 AI model providers and nine of the top 10 AI clouds are deployed with Equinix.

confidence.basis: Self-reported marketing claim in the company's own press release, with no named customers or independent verification.
